step3_patient_anchor.coreference_notes: Primary subject of case presentation; 41-year-old male presenting with painful cervical lymphadenopathy and arthralgia

step5_concept_grounding: Suspected diagnosis of Chikungunya evaluated in patient with necrotizing lymphadenitis and arthralgia

evidence_items.source_quote: The chikungunya IgM antibody was not detected by serum IgM ELISA.

step10_contradiction_notes: Clinicians made an unconfirmed clinical diagnosis of chikungunya based on history and symptoms, but disease-specific serum IgM ELISA was explicitly negative (not detected), failing the gold standard laboratory evidence requirement.
rationale: A 41-year-old male with painful cervical lymphadenopathy, fever, and later polyarthralgia. While clinicians posited a clinical diagnosis based on symptoms, specific laboratory testing was explicitly negative: 'The chikungunya IgM antibody was not detected by serum IgM ELISA' (E0 refuting/contradicted evidence). Under strict gold-standard curation rules, supportive symptoms (E3) in the presence of a negative specific assay fail VPD criteria. Assigned NEGATIVE.

step3_patient_anchor.coreference_notes: Primary subject of case 4; 12-year-old male with fever, rash, and subsequently confirmed rickettsiosis

step5_concept_grounding: Initial clinical diagnosis of Chikungunya evaluated and contradicted by negative testing

evidence_items.source_quote: On this occasion, samples were taken to confirm chikungunya, yielding negative results.

step10_contradiction_notes: Initial presumptive clinical diagnosis of chikungunya without lab confirmation was contradicted by negative laboratory tests on day 10 and subsequent positive serology for Rickettsia typhi.
rationale: A 12-year-old male was initially presumptively diagnosed with chikungunya clinically without testing. Upon re-evaluation on day 10, laboratory testing was performed to confirm chikungunya and yielded negative results (E0 contradictory evidence). The patient was subsequently confirmed to have Rickettsia typhi infection. Assigned NEGATIVE.
